interview.familyPedigree.aboutThisPerson.description: Heading above the name, gender identity and sex assigned at birth questions in the side panel for adding a family member.

interview.familyPedigree.actionsLabel.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your relatives} other {Add relatives of {name}}}
interview.familyPedigree.actionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons that appears around a selected family member, used to add their parent, sibling, partner or child.

interview.familyPedigree.add.description: Button at the bottom of the side panel that adds the new family member.

interview.familyPedigree.addChild.description: Short button label next to a selected family member: adds a child of that person.

interview.familyPedigree.addChildTitle.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your child} other {Add a child of {name}}}
interview.familyPedigree.addChildTitle.description: Title of the side panel used to add a child of a family member. {name} is that family member’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.addParent.description: Short button label next to a selected family member: adds a parent of that person.

interview.familyPedigree.addParentTitle.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your parent} other {Add a parent of {name}}}
interview.familyPedigree.addParentTitle.description: Title of the side panel used to add a parent of a family member. {name} is that family member’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.addPartner.description: Short button label next to a selected family member: adds a partner (spouse or romantic partner, current or former) of that person.

interview.familyPedigree.addPartnerTitle.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your partner} other {Add a partner of {name}}}
interview.familyPedigree.addPartnerTitle.description: Title of the side panel used to add a partner of a family member. {name} is that family member’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.addSibling.description: Short button label next to a selected family member: adds a brother, sister or sibling of that person.

interview.familyPedigree.addSiblingTitle.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your sibling} other {Add a sibling of {name}}}
interview.familyPedigree.addSiblingTitle.description: Title of the side panel used to add a sibling of a family member. {name} is that family member’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.addedAnnounceme.description: Screen reader announcement after a family member is added. {name} is their name or, when it is not known, how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.alsoParentOfLab.defaultMessage: Are they also the parent of…
interview.familyPedigree.alsoParentOfLab.description: Question in the side panel for adding a parent: which of the selected person’s siblings share this parent. Options are the siblings’ names.

interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {Both you and “{second}”} other {Both “{first}” and “{second}”}}
interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.description: Option: both parents of the new child are its biological parents. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.defaultMessage: A parent who is not a biological parent is added as a step or social parent.
interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.description: Hint under the question asking which parent of a new child is a biological parent.

interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.defaultMessage: Who is the child’s biological parent?
interview.familyPedigree.biologicalParen.description: Question in the side panel for adding a biological child with a partner as the other parent. Options are both of them, or either one.

interview.familyPedigree.cancel.description: Button that closes the side panel without saving.

interview.familyPedigree.canvasLabel.description: Accessible name for the area showing the family members the participant has added, drawn as a family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.carriedPregnanc.defaultMessage: Did this parent carry the pregnancy?
interview.familyPedigree.carriedPregnanc.description: Yes/no question in the side panel for adding a biological parent: whether they were pregnant with the child.

interview.familyPedigree.carrierLabel.description: Question in the side panel for adding a biological child. Options are the child’s parents’ names, or someone else / not known.

interview.familyPedigree.carrierUnknown.defaultMessage: Someone else, or I don’t know
interview.familyPedigree.carrierUnknown.description: Option: neither parent shown carried the pregnancy, or the participant does not know.

interview.familyPedigree.childKind.socia.defaultMessage: A step-child or other child they raise
interview.familyPedigree.childKind.socia.description: Option: a child who is neither genetically related nor adopted, such as a step-child.

interview.familyPedigree.childKindLabel.description: Question in the side panel for adding a child: how the child is related to their parents. Followed by the options below.

interview.familyPedigree.childrenAnswere.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Recorded that you have no biological children.} other {Recorded that “{name}” has no biological children.}}
interview.familyPedigree.childrenAnswere.description: Screen reader announcement after answering, from the list of family members still needed, that a person has no children. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.connectAlreadyC.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {You and “{second}” are already connected.} other {“{first}” and “{second}” are already connected.}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectAlreadyC.description: Shown under the toolbar, and read out, when the participant selects two people to connect who are already connected. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.connectBack.description: Option in the menu for connecting two people, after choosing that one is the other’s parent: return to the list of relationships.

interview.familyPedigree.connectFormerPa.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {You and “{second}” were partners} other {“{first}” and “{second}” were partners}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectFormerPa.description: Option in the menu for connecting two people: they were a couple but are no longer together.

interview.familyPedigree.connectHint.defaultMessage: Select a person, then select another to connect them.
interview.familyPedigree.connectHint.description: Instruction shown under the toolbar while the tool for connecting two people is on.

interview.familyPedigree.connectHintLink.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Now select the person to connect to you.} other {Now select the person to connect to “{name}”.}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectHintLink.description: Instruction shown under the toolbar once the first of two people to connect has been selected. name is that person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.connectParent.defaultMessage: {parentIsYou, select, true {You are a parent of “{child}”} other {{childIsYou, select, true {“{parent}” is your parent} other {“{parent}” is a parent of “{child}”}}}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectParent.description: Option in the menu for connecting two people, opening a list of kinds of parent (biological, adoptive and so on). parent and child are names or how the people are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.connectPartners.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {You and “{second}” are partners} other {“{first}” and “{second}” are partners}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectPartners.description: Option in the menu for connecting two people: they are, or were, a couple.

interview.familyPedigree.connectQuestion.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {How are you and “{second}” related?} other {How are “{first}” and “{second}” related?}}
interview.familyPedigree.connectQuestion.description: Heading of the menu that appears after selecting two people to connect. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.connectTool.description: Short label of a toolbar button, shown beside its icon, so keep it brief. While it is on, selecting one person and then another connects them, for relatives added separately.

interview.familyPedigree.connectedParent.description: Screen reader announcement after connecting two people as parent and child. relationship is the chosen menu option (for example “Julie” is a parent of “Rob”); kind is the kind of parent chosen (for example Adoptive parent).

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectConfi.description: Button in the confirmation that removes the connection between two people.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectConfi.defaultMessage: Both people stay in your family tree. Only the connection between them is removed.
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectConfi.description: Explanation in the confirmation shown before removing the connection between two people.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectConfi.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {Remove the connection between you and “{second}”?} other {Remove the connection between “{first}” and “{second}”?}}
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectConfi.description: Title of the confirmation shown before removing the connection between two people. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectHint.defaultMessage: Select a person, then select someone they are connected to, to remove that connection.
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectHint.description: Instruction shown under the toolbar while the tool for removing a connection between two people is on.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectHintL.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Now select the person to disconnect from you.} other {Now select the person to disconnect from “{name}”.}}
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectHintL.description: Instruction shown under the toolbar once the first of two people to disconnect has been selected. name is that person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectNotCo.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {You and “{second}” are not connected.} other {“{first}” and “{second}” are not connected.}}
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectNotCo.description: Shown under the toolbar, and read out, when the participant selects two people to disconnect who have no connection between them. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectTool.description: Short label of a toolbar button, shown beside its icon, so keep it brief. While it is on, selecting one person and then someone they are connected to removes the connection between them, leaving both people in the family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.disconnectedAnn.defaultMessage: {firstIsYou, select, true {The connection between you and “{second}” was removed.} other {The connection between “{first}” and “{second}” was removed.}}
interview.familyPedigree.disconnectedAnn.description: Screen reader announcement after the connection between two people is removed. first and second are their names or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.dontKnow.description: Answer option for a question about a family member, when the participant does not know.

interview.familyPedigree.editTitle.description: Title of the side panel showing the details about a family member. {name} is that family member’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.familyMember.description: Label for a family member whose name is not known and who is not connected to the participant in the family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.familySection.description: Heading of the questions in a family member’s details about whether they have siblings or children.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceDe.defaultMessage: Choose the words you would like us to use for the people in your family. You can change this at any time.
interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceDe.description: Explanation under the heading of the popover asking which words to use for family members.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGa.description: Option in the popover asking which words to use for family members: words that do not depend on anyone’s gender.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGa.defaultMessage: Words that do not depend on anyone’s gender. Biological parents are described by whether they gave the egg or the sperm, and everyone else with words like grandparent or parent’s sibling.
interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGa.description: Explanation of the option to describe family members without reference to gender.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGe.description: Option in the popover asking which words to use for family members: the usual words, chosen by each person’s gender.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGe.defaultMessage: Words that follow each person’s gender, such as grandmother, uncle or niece. Anyone who is neither a woman nor a man is described with words like parent or sibling.
interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceGe.description: Explanation of the option to describe family members by their gender.

interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceTi.defaultMessage: How should we describe your family?
interview.familyPedigree.framingChoiceTi.description: Heading of the popover, opened from the stage’s toolbar, that asks which words to use for family members. Open when the participant first reaches the stage.

interview.familyPedigree.framingControlL.description: Short label of the toolbar button, shown beside its icon, that opens the choice of words used to describe family members (such as “mother” or “egg parent”). Keep it brief.

interview.familyPedigree.genderIdentityL.description: Label of the question about a family member’s gender.

interview.familyPedigree.hasChildrenQues.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Do you have any biological children?} other {Does {name} have any biological children?}}
interview.familyPedigree.hasChildrenQues.description: Question in a family member’s details. Answering yes means the participant will add them to the family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.hasRelativesYes.defaultMessage: Yes — I’ll add them to the family tree
interview.familyPedigree.hasRelativesYes.description: Answer to whether a family member has siblings or children: yes, and the participant will add them.

interview.familyPedigree.hasSiblingsQues.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Do you have any biological brothers or sisters, including half-brothers and half-sisters?} other {Does {name} have any biological brothers or sisters, including half-brothers and half-sisters?}}
interview.familyPedigree.hasSiblingsQues.description: Question in a family member’s details. Answering yes means the participant will add them to the family tree. Includes half-siblings who share one biological parent.

interview.familyPedigree.itemChildren.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your biological children, or say you have none} other {Add biological children for “{name}”, or say they have none}}
interview.familyPedigree.itemChildren.description: Item in the list of family members still needed: the person’s biological children, or an answer that they have none or that the participant does not know. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.itemDetails.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Some details are missing about you} other {Some details are missing for “{name}”}}
interview.familyPedigree.itemDetails.description: Item in the list of what is still needed before continuing: questions about this person that the study requires have not been answered. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.itemParents.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {{missing, plural, one {Add your other biological parent} other {Add your biological parents}}} other {{missing, plural, one {Add another biological parent for “{name}”} other {Add biological parents for “{name}”}}}}
interview.familyPedigree.itemParents.description: Item in the list of family members still needed. missing is how many biological parents the person still needs (1 or 2). name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant. Biological parents include an egg or sperm donor.

interview.familyPedigree.itemSiblings.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Add your biological brothers and sisters, or say you have none} other {Add biological brothers and sisters for “{name}”, or say they have none}}
interview.familyPedigree.itemSiblings.description: Item in the list of family members still needed: the person’s siblings (including half-siblings), or an answer that they have none or that the participant does not know. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.missingDetails.description: Tooltip on the warning icon next to a family member whose required details have not been given yet.

interview.familyPedigree.missingDetailsL.description: Notice at the top of the panel showing a family member’s details. {details} is a list of the questions not yet answered, e.g. “Name and Gender identity”.

interview.familyPedigree.moreAboutThisPe.description: Heading above the study’s own additional questions about a family member.

interview.familyPedigree.nameHint.defaultMessage: A first name or nickname is fine. If you don’t know it, leave this blank and they will be shown by how they are related to you.
interview.familyPedigree.nameHint.description: Hint beneath the field for a family member’s name.

interview.familyPedigree.nameLabel.description: Label of the field for a family member’s name, which the participant may not know.

interview.familyPedigree.numberedRelativ.description: Tells apart several family members who would otherwise share a label (for example two unnamed children). label is the already translated label; number is their position in the order they were added.

interview.familyPedigree.otherParentLabe.defaultMessage: Who is the child’s other parent?
interview.familyPedigree.otherParentLabe.description: Question in the side panel for adding a child. Options are the selected person’s partners, someone not in the family tree yet, or no other parent.

interview.familyPedigree.otherParentNone.description: Option: the child has only the one parent.

interview.familyPedigree.otherParentUnkn.description: Option: the child’s other parent is not in the family tree yet; an unnamed person is added to fill in later.

interview.familyPedigree.parentCarriedLa.defaultMessage: {parentIsYou, select, true {Did you carry the pregnancy?} other {Did {parent} carry the pregnancy?}}
interview.familyPedigree.parentCarriedLa.description: Yes/no question in the details panel: whether this biological parent was pregnant with the family member. {parent} is the parent’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.biol.description: Option: a genetic parent, who contributed an egg or sperm and raised the child or was otherwise their parent.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.biol.defaultMessage: Biological parent who carried the pregnancy
interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.biol.description: Option in the menu for connecting a parent and child: a genetic parent who was also pregnant with the child.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.dono.description: Option: someone who donated an egg or sperm but did not raise the child.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.soci.description: Option: a parent who is not genetically related and did not adopt — for example a step-parent.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKind.surr.description: Option: someone who carried the pregnancy for someone else and is not genetically related to the child.

interview.familyPedigree.parentKindLabel.defaultMessage: What kind of parent are they?
interview.familyPedigree.parentKindLabel.description: Question in the side panel for adding a parent: how the new person is a parent of the selected family member.

interview.familyPedigree.parentLinkKindL.defaultMessage: {parentIsYou, select, true {You are their…} other {{personIsYou, select, true {{parent} is your…} other {{parent} is their…}}}}
interview.familyPedigree.parentLinkKindL.description: Question in the details panel about one of the family member’s parents, as the start of a sentence that the chosen option completes: “Father is your… Adoptive parent”. {parent} is the parent’s name, or how they are related to the participant (such as “Father”) when unnamed; “their” is the family member whose details are open. Options are the kinds of parent: “Biological parent”, “Adoptive parent”, “Step or social parent”, “Egg or sperm donor”, “Surrogate”.

interview.familyPedigree.parentPartnerLa.defaultMessage: Are they the partner of another parent?
interview.familyPedigree.parentPartnerLa.description: Question in the side panel for adding a parent: whether the new parent is (or was) the partner of a parent already in the family tree. Options are those parents’ names, or “No”.

interview.familyPedigree.partnershipCurr.description: Yes/no question: whether a partnership is current, rather than separated or ended.

interview.familyPedigree.personAccessibl.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {You} other {{name}}}{missing, select, true {, some details missing} other {}}
interview.familyPedigree.personAccessibl.description: Accessible name of a family member’s symbol in the family tree. {name} is the person’s name or, when it is not known, how they are related to the participant. The second part is read out when required details about the person have not been given yet.

interview.familyPedigree.placeholderPare.defaultMessage: {framing, select, gamete {An egg parent and a sperm parent will be added for you to fill in later, so the family tree can show these siblings together.} other {A biological mother and a biological father will be added for you to fill in later, so the family tree can show these siblings together.}}
interview.familyPedigree.placeholderPare.description: Note in the side panel for adding a sibling, shown when the selected person has no parents yet.

interview.familyPedigree.pointerTool.description: Short label of a toolbar button, shown beside its icon, so keep it brief. While it is on, selecting a person opens their details and shows buttons to add their relatives.

interview.familyPedigree.preferNotToSay.description: Answer option for a question about a family member, when the participant would rather not answer.

interview.familyPedigree.relationshipSec.description: Heading above the questions about how a new family member is related to the selected person.

interview.familyPedigree.relationshipsSe.description: Heading above the questions about a family member’s existing partnerships and parents, in the panel showing their details.

interview.familyPedigree.relativeOf.defaultMessage: {owner}'s {term, select, mother {mother} father {father} parent {parent} eggParent {egg parent} spermParent {sperm parent} biologicalMother {bio­logical mother} biologicalFather {bio­logical father} adoptiveMother {adoptive mother} adoptiveFather {adoptive father} adoptiveParent {adoptive parent} stepmother {stepmother} stepfather {stepfather} stepparent {step-parent} eggDonor {egg donor} spermDonor {sperm donor} donor {donor} surrogate {surrogate} daughter {daughter} son {son} child {child} stepdaughter {stepdaughter} stepson {stepson} stepchild {stepchild} donorConceivedChild {donor-conceived child} surrogacyChild {child born through surrogacy} sister {sister} brother {brother} sibling {sibling} halfSister {half-sister} halfBrother {half-brother} halfSibling {half-sibling} stepsister {stepsister} stepbrother {stepbrother} stepsibling {step-sibling} partner {partner} formerPartner {former partner} other {relative}}
interview.familyPedigree.relativeOf.description: Label for a family member whose name is not known and who has no everyday kinship word, described through a relative of theirs: owner is that relative’s label (for example “Cousin”), and term is how this person is related to them. Translate the possessive grammar as a whole; owner stays verbatim. Display only.

Labels sit inside a small circle, so a long word carries a soft hyphen (U+00AD) where it may break; add one to long words in your language.

interview.familyPedigree.remove.description: Button in the side panel that removes a family member from the family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.removeConfirmDe.defaultMessage: They will be removed from your family tree, along with their connections to other people.
interview.familyPedigree.removeConfirmDe.description: Explanation in the confirmation shown before removing a family member.

interview.familyPedigree.removeConfirmTi.description: Title of the confirmation shown before removing a family member. {name} is their name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.removedAnnounce.description: Screen reader announcement after a family member is removed. {name} is their name or, when it is not known, how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.save.description: Button at the bottom of the side panel that saves changes to a family member’s details.

interview.familyPedigree.savedAnnounceme.description: Screen reader announcement after a family member’s details are saved.

interview.familyPedigree.sexAssignedAtBi.description: Label of the question about the sex a family member was assigned at birth.

interview.familyPedigree.sexRuledOutHint.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Some answers are unavailable because they do not fit how you are connected to your children. To choose one, change or remove that connection first.} other {Some answers are unavailable because they do not fit how this person is connected to their children. To choose one, change or remove that connection first.}}
interview.familyPedigree.sexRuledOutHint.description: Hint under the sex assigned at birth question when some answers contradict the person’s recorded children: for example, a child cannot have two biological parents who were both assigned male at birth.

interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentCou.description: Option: the new sibling shares both parents (a full sibling).

interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentCou.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Which parents do they share with you?} other {Which parents do they share with “{name}”?}}
interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentCou.description: Question in the side panel for adding a sibling: which parents the two siblings have in common. Options are the parents’ names, or for someone with no parents yet, both or one of the parents who will be added. name is that person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentEgg.defaultMessage: {framing, select, gamete {Only the egg parent} other {Only the biological mother}}
interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentEgg.description: Option: the new sibling shares only the parent who provided the egg (a half-sibling). Gendered or gamete wording depends on the study.

interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentSpe.defaultMessage: {framing, select, gamete {Only the sperm parent} other {Only the biological father}}
interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentSpe.description: Option: the new sibling shares only the parent who provided the sperm (a half-sibling). Gendered or gamete wording depends on the study.

interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentUns.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Your other parent, not shown yet} other {The other parent of “{name}”, not shown yet}}
interview.familyPedigree.sharedParentUns.description: Option when choosing which parents a new sibling shares, for someone with one parent recorded: their second parent, who is added unnamed for both of them.

interview.familyPedigree.showWholeFamily.description: Toolbar button that zooms and moves the family tree so everyone in it fits on screen.

interview.familyPedigree.siblingKindHint.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {This can differ from how you are related to them, for example if only one of you was adopted.} other {This can differ from how “{name}” is related to them, for example if only one of the two siblings was adopted.}}
interview.familyPedigree.siblingKindHint.description: Hint under the question about how a new sibling is related to the parents they share. name is the person the sibling is being added to.

interview.familyPedigree.siblingKindLabe.defaultMessage: To the parents they share, are they…
interview.familyPedigree.siblingKindLabe.description: Question in the side panel for adding a sibling: how the new sibling is related to the parents chosen above. Followed by the options "A biological child", "An adopted child", "A step-child or other child they raise".

interview.familyPedigree.siblingsAnswere.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {Recorded that you have no biological brothers or sisters.} other {Recorded that “{name}” has no biological brothers or sisters.}}
interview.familyPedigree.siblingsAnswere.description: Screen reader announcement after answering, from the list of family members still needed, that a person has no siblings. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.stillTogetherLa.defaultMessage: {personIsYou, select, true {Are you still together with {partner}?} other {{partnerIsYou, select, true {Are you still together?} other {Are they still together with {partner}?}}}}
interview.familyPedigree.stillTogetherLa.description: Yes/no question in the details panel about one of the family member’s partnerships: whether it is current, rather than separated or ended. {partner} is the partner’s name or “Unnamed”.

interview.familyPedigree.toolGroupLabel.description: Accessible name of the pair of buttons in the toolbar that choose what selecting a person does.

interview.familyPedigree.toolsLabel.description: Accessible name of the toolbar above the family tree, which switches between adding or editing people, connecting two people, and removing the connection between two people.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerComplete.defaultMessage: Your family tree has everything needed. You can continue.
interview.familyPedigree.trackerComplete.description: Shown in the list of family members still needed once nothing more is needed.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerNoChildr.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {I have no biological children} other {“{name}” has no biological children}}
interview.familyPedigree.trackerNoChildr.description: Button under an item in the list of family members still needed: records that the person has no biological children. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerNoSiblin.defaultMessage: {isYou, select, true {I have no biological siblings} other {“{name}” has no biological siblings}}
interview.familyPedigree.trackerNoSiblin.description: Button under an item in the list of family members still needed: records that the person has no siblings who share a biological parent. name is the person’s name or how they are related to the participant.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerProgress.defaultMessage: {complete, select, true {Your family tree has everything needed} other {Family tree {percent, number, percent} complete}}. Show what’s still needed.
interview.familyPedigree.trackerProgress.description: Accessible name of the round progress indicator in the corner of the family tree, which opens the list of family members still needed. percent is a fraction between 0 and 1.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerRecommen.defaultMessage: You can also continue without these by pressing Next again.
interview.familyPedigree.trackerRecommen.description: Note beneath the list of family members still needed, when the study recommends rather than requires them.

interview.familyPedigree.trackerTitle.defaultMessage: Before you continue, please complete the following:
interview.familyPedigree.trackerTitle.description: Heading of the list of family members the participant still needs to add before moving on.

interview.familyPedigree.you.description: Label shown beneath the participant’s own symbol in their family tree.

interview.familyPedigree.yourNameLabel.description: Label of the field for the participant’s own name.

interview.familyPedigree.zoomIn.description: Toolbar button that makes the family tree larger.

interview.familyPedigree.zoomOut.description: Toolbar button that makes the family tree smaller.

interview.interfaces.addNamePlaceholder.defaultMessage: Type a name, then press Enter
interview.interfaces.addNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the network-composer name field; pressing Enter adds the named item.

interview.interfaces.addNode.description: Accessible name of the network-composer tool that opens a field to add a new network item.

interview.interfaces.addedNodes.description: Accessible name used by drag-and-drop announcements for the list of people already added to the network.

interview.interfaces.attributes.description: Narrative legend heading for attributes used to highlight people. Individual attribute labels come unchanged from the protocol.

interview.interfaces.automaticLayout.description: Toggle that automatically positions people in the network composer.

interview.interfaces.availableItems.defaultMessage: List of available items to add
interview.interfaces.availableItems.description: Accessible name of the collection containing external roster entries that can be added.

interview.interfaces.availableRosterNode.description: Accessible name used by drag-and-drop announcements for the external roster entries that can still be added.

interview.interfaces.availableToAdd.description: Heading above the external roster entries that the participant can add to their network.

interview.interfaces.binSummary.description: Whole categorical-bin summary. name is the first item’s unchanged display name; otherCount excludes that item. label and count tags keep the name and remaining-item count in separate visual spans.

interview.interfaces.categoryContents.defaultMessage: Category {label}, {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
interview.interfaces.categoryContents.description: Accessible name of a collapsed category container. label is its authored category label; count is the number of items currently in the container.

interview.interfaces.categoryContentsExp.defaultMessage: Category {label}, {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, expanded
interview.interfaces.categoryContentsExp.description: Accessible name of an expanded category container. label is its authored label; count is the number of items currently in it.

interview.interfaces.categoryDrop.description: Drag target announcement for a categorical response. label is the unchanged researcher-authored category label.

interview.interfaces.categoryList.description: Accessible name of the item list inside an expanded category. label is the unchanged researcher-authored category label.

interview.interfaces.clearSearch.description: Accessible action that clears the current geospatial search query.

interview.interfaces.closeSearch.description: Accessible name of the toggle while the geospatial place-search panel is open.

interview.interfaces.composerTools.description: Accessible name of the vertical toolbar used to create and edit a network.

interview.interfaces.confirmPassphrase.description: Label of the second anonymisation password field; this is confirmation of the passphrase, not a separate password.

interview.interfaces.deselect.description: Action that clears the current outside-map-area selection so the participant can choose another location.

interview.interfaces.disableDrawing.description: Toggle action that turns off freehand drawing on the narrative canvas.

interview.interfaces.discardChanges.description: Confirmation action that leaves an invalid form and discards its unsaved changes.

interview.interfaces.discardChangesDescr.defaultMessage: This form contains invalid data, so it cannot be saved. If you continue it will be reset, and your changes will be lost. Do you want to discard your changes?
interview.interfaces.discardChangesDescr.description: Warning when leaving a form with invalid unsaved answers. Continuing resets the form, so its unsaved changes will be lost.

interview.interfaces.discardChangesTitle.description: Title of the warning shown when a participant tries to leave a form containing invalid unsaved answers.

interview.interfaces.dragToReposition.description: Accessible name of the handle that moves the floating narrative preset toolbar.

interview.interfaces.drawEdge.description: Accessible name of the network-composer tool that creates a connection between two items.

interview.interfaces.drawingControls.description: Accessible name of the narrative toolbar group for freehand annotations.

interview.interfaces.editingTools.description: Accessible name of the toolbar group for selection, adding people, creating connections, and group membership.

interview.interfaces.emptyRoster.defaultMessage: There is nothing to add from this list.
interview.interfaces.emptyRoster.description: Empty state after an external roster has loaded successfully but contains no entries.

interview.interfaces.enableDrawing.description: Toggle action that turns on freehand drawing on the narrative canvas.

interview.interfaces.entityName.description: Accessible name for a new-item name field. entityLabel is the unchanged, researcher-authored label for the network entity type.

interview.interfaces.equalSplit.description: Divider preset that gives equal space to the source panels and the added-people list in the name generator.

interview.interfaces.errorHeading.description: Short heading above an external-list loading error. This heading intentionally has no final period.

interview.interfaces.externalDataUnavail.defaultMessage: External data could not be loaded.
interview.interfaces.externalDataUnavail.description: Explanation shown when a configured external list of people could not be loaded.

interview.interfaces.finish.description: Button on the final interview screen that opens the finish confirmation dialog.

interview.interfaces.finishConfirmation.defaultMessage: Are you sure you want to finish the interview?
interview.interfaces.finishConfirmation.description: Title of the confirmation dialog opened by the finish button at the end of an interview.

interview.interfaces.finishDescription.defaultMessage: You have reached the end of the interview. If you are satisfied with the information you have entered, you may finish the interview now.
interview.interfaces.finishDescription.description: Guidance on the final interview screen before the participant opens the finish confirmation dialog.

interview.interfaces.finishInterview.description: End-of-interview page heading and confirmation action that finishes the current interview.

interview.interfaces.finished.description: Button that submits and closes the form for adding or editing a person; it does not finish the whole interview.

interview.interfaces.formDisabled.description: Form-level error when a quick-add submission is attempted while that form is disabled.

interview.interfaces.freezeAnnotations.description: Toggle action that locks existing narrative annotations in place.

interview.interfaces.groupMembershipOpti.description: Accessible name of the popover containing group membership choices in the network composer.

interview.interfaces.groupMembershipPeop.description: Accessible name of the controls that set group membership for the currently selected people.

interview.interfaces.groups.description: Network-composer tool label and narrative legend heading for groups of people.

interview.interfaces.hideInstructions.description: Accessible action that collapses the floating instructions panel above a network view.

interview.interfaces.historyTools.description: Accessible name of the toolbar group containing undo and redo actions.

interview.interfaces.keepChanges.description: Cancellation action in the discard-changes warning; the participant stays on the current form to continue editing.

interview.interfaces.layoutAndDrawing.description: Accessible name of the narrative toolbar for automatic positioning and freehand annotations.

interview.interfaces.layoutControls.description: Accessible name of the narrative toolbar group that pauses or resumes automatic positioning.

interview.interfaces.layoutTools.description: Accessible name of the network-composer toolbar group that controls automatic positioning.

interview.interfaces.links.description: Narrative legend heading for displayed connection types. Individual connection labels come unchanged from the protocol.

interview.interfaces.loading.description: Loading indicator while an external list of people is being read. Keeps the existing three-dot punctuation of this interface.

interview.interfaces.mapMoved.description: Screen-reader announcement after a selected search result moves the map. place is the unchanged place name returned by the map service.

interview.interfaces.mapTitle.description: Accessible region name of the native Mapbox canvas in the geospatial interface.

interview.interfaces.mapUnavailable.defaultMessage: The map could not be displayed
interview.interfaces.mapUnavailable.description: Heading when the participant’s device or browser cannot initialize the map.

interview.interfaces.mapUnavailableDescr.defaultMessage: This can happen if your browser or device does not support the features the map requires (for example, WebGL). Try a different browser or device, or contact the study organizer. You may be able to continue your interview by selecting the next arrow.
interview.interfaces.mapUnavailableDescr.description: Recovery guidance after map initialization fails. The next arrow refers to the interview navigation control, not a map control.

interview.interfaces.mapboxHomepage.description: Accessible name of the native map logo link that opens the Mapbox homepage; preserve the Mapbox brand name.

interview.interfaces.missingInterface.description: Fallback error when the runtime cannot render a configured interface type. interfaceType is the unchanged technical type identifier for diagnosing the unsupported configuration.

interview.interfaces.namedReturnedToDraw.description: Screen-reader announcement after an item is returned to the unplaced-items panel. name is its unchanged participant-entered or authored display name.

interview.interfaces.nextPreset.description: Action that selects the next researcher-configured narrative view.

interview.interfaces.no.description: Negative built-in binary response in pair comparisons and human-readable display of false roster values. The stored boolean remains false.

interview.interfaces.noAttributes.description: Empty state in the network-composer editing panel when the selected item has no configured form fields.

interview.interfaces.noNodes.description: Empty state when a one-to-many relationship question has no people to display.

interview.interfaces.noNodesAvailable.description: Empty state when the current one-to-many question has no available people for its focal position.

interview.interfaces.noSearchResults.description: Outcome of a completed geospatial search with no matching places. Do not use this for network failures.

interview.interfaces.node.description: Capitalized fallback label when a displayed network item has no authored type name or usable participant-entered name.

interview.interfaces.nodeSubject.description: Lowercase fallback subject noun in the generated unnamed-roster-entry label when the protocol supplies no type name.

interview.interfaces.oneThirdPanels.description: Divider preset that assigns one third of the available area to the source panels in the name generator.

interview.interfaces.ordinalContainer.description: Drag-and-drop name of a rating container. label is the unchanged researcher-authored ordinal response label; keep it as a value, not a translation key.

interview.interfaces.outsideMapDescripti.defaultMessage: You have indicated an area outside of the selectable map. If this is correct, please select the next arrow to proceed.
interview.interfaces.outsideMapDescripti.description: Confirmation guidance when the participant indicates a location outside the selectable map areas. The next arrow advances the interview.

interview.interfaces.outsideSelectableAr.description: Button used to indicate that the participant’s location lies outside the selectable map areas. The stored selection identifier is never translated.

interview.interfaces.passphraseSet.defaultMessage: Passphrase set successfully! Click "Next" to continue.
interview.interfaces.passphraseSet.description: Success message after the participant sets the anonymisation passphrase. Next refers to the interview navigation arrow.

interview.interfaces.pauseAutoLayout.description: Visible sociogram button that pauses automatic positioning. Its capitalization differs from the narrative icon tooltip.

interview.interfaces.pauseAutomaticLayou.description: Accessible action that pauses automatic movement of the displayed people in a narrative view.

interview.interfaces.placeUnavailable.defaultMessage: That place could not be loaded. Try another search.
interview.interfaces.placeUnavailable.description: Recoverable error when a chosen geospatial search suggestion could not be retrieved and the map could not move to it.

interview.interfaces.presetNavigation.description: Accessible name of the toolbar group that switches between researcher-configured narrative views.

interview.interfaces.presets.description: Accessible name of the narrative toolbar for switching between researcher-configured network views.

interview.interfaces.previousPreset.description: Action that selects the previous researcher-configured narrative view.

interview.interfaces.quarterPanels.description: Divider preset that assigns 25 percent of the available area to the source panels in the name generator.

interview.interfaces.quickAddInput.description: Accessible name of the active quick-add toggle while its name-entry field is open.

interview.interfaces.quickAddInstruction.description: Tooltip beside the quick-add name field. The kbd tag marks the Enter key and must be preserved.

interview.interfaces.quickAddMultipleIns.defaultMessage: Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> when you are finished. The box will stay open so you can quickly enter multiple names in a row.
interview.interfaces.quickAddMultipleIns.description: Tooltip when quick-add supports consecutive entries. The field stays open after each submission. The kbd tag marks the Enter key.

interview.interfaces.quickLabelPlacehold.defaultMessage: Type a label and press enter...
interview.interfaces.quickLabelPlacehold.description: Placeholder in the quick-add field for entering the label of a new network item; Enter submits the value.

interview.interfaces.recenterMap.description: Accessible name of the map button that restores the researcher-configured starting center and zoom.

interview.interfaces.redo.description: Toolbar action that reapplies an edit that was undone in the network composer.

interview.interfaces.reenterPassphrase.description: Placeholder in the second anonymisation password field, where the participant repeats their new passphrase for confirmation.

interview.interfaces.resetAnnotations.description: Action that clears the freehand annotations from the narrative canvas.

interview.interfaces.resizePanel.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider that changes the width of the network-composer editing panel.

interview.interfaces.resizePanels.defaultMessage: Resize panel and node list areas
interview.interfaces.resizePanels.description: Accessible name of the divider between the source panel and the list of added people; dragging or keyboard controls resize the two areas.

interview.interfaces.responsePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the explanation field of the categorical Other dialog. The visible question label remains researcher-authored.

interview.interfaces.resumeAutoLayout.description: Visible sociogram button that resumes automatic positioning. Its capitalization differs from the narrative icon tooltip.

interview.interfaces.resumeAutomaticLayo.description: Accessible action that resumes automatic movement of the displayed people in a narrative view.

interview.interfaces.returnedToDrawer.description: Screen-reader announcement after an item without a usable name is removed from the canvas and returned to the unplaced-items panel.

interview.interfaces.rosterAlreadyAdded.defaultMessage: Everything from this list has already been added.
interview.interfaces.rosterAlreadyAdded.description: Empty state when every entry from an external roster has already been added to the interview network.

interview.interfaces.scrollForQuestions.description: Hint at the bottom of a long personal-information form indicating that more questions are below the visible area.

interview.interfaces.searchFailed.defaultMessage: Search could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
interview.interfaces.searchFailed.description: Recoverable error when geospatial search could not run; it does not mean the place does not exist.

interview.interfaces.searchLocation.description: Accessible name of the toggle that opens the geospatial place-search panel.

interview.interfaces.searchPlace.description: Placeholder in the geospatial search field where the participant enters a place name.

interview.interfaces.searchSuggestions.description: Accessible name of the list of places returned by geospatial search, including its loading and empty states.

interview.interfaces.searchTerm.description: Placeholder in the filter field above an external roster; it searches the available roster entries.

interview.interfaces.searching.description: Status shown in the geospatial search results panel while a search request is pending.

interview.interfaces.select.description: Network-composer tool that selects existing people or connections for editing.

interview.interfaces.selectAllThenNext.defaultMessage: Select all that apply, then click next
interview.interfaces.selectAllThenNext.description: Heading above a one-to-many relationship question. The participant may select multiple people before using the next navigation arrow.

interview.interfaces.selectResponse.defaultMessage: Please select a response before continuing.
interview.interfaces.selectResponse.description: Warning shown when the participant tries to advance a pair-comparison question without choosing a response.

interview.interfaces.showInstructions.description: Accessible action that expands the floating instructions panel above a network view.

interview.interfaces.specifyOther.description: Title of the dialog opened when an item is placed in a categorical Other response and a written explanation is required.

interview.interfaces.stubMap.defaultMessage: Stubbed map (click to select test feature)
interview.interfaces.stubMap.description: Accessible name of the test-only map placeholder used by automated interface tests; clicking it selects a fixture feature.

interview.interfaces.submit.description: Accessible name of icon-only or visually hidden form submit buttons in anonymisation and slide forms.

interview.interfaces.targetNodes.description: Accessible name of the collection of people that can be selected in a one-to-many relationship question.

interview.interfaces.toggleAttribution.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the native map control that expands or collapses map source credits; source credit text remains unchanged.

interview.interfaces.undo.description: Toolbar action that reverses the most recent edit in the network composer.

interview.interfaces.unfreezeAnnotations.description: Toggle action that allows existing narrative annotations to be edited again.

interview.interfaces.yes.description: Affirmative built-in binary response in pair comparisons and human-readable display of true roster values. The stored boolean remains true.

interview.interfaces.zoomIn.description: Accessible name of the geospatial map button that increases magnification. Keeps the existing title capitalization.

interview.interfaces.zoomOut.description: Accessible name of the geospatial map button that decreases magnification. Keeps the existing title capitalization.

interview.navigation.automaticLanguage.description: Language option that follows the host's requested interface language.

interview.navigation.currentTextSize.description: Screen-reader announcement after the participant changes text size; size is a multiplier.

interview.navigation.decreaseTextSize.description: Accessible action that decreases interview text size.

interview.navigation.exitInterview.description: Action to leave an unfinished interview while preserving answers.

interview.navigation.exitInterviewDescri.defaultMessage: Your answers so far will be saved and you can continue later.
interview.navigation.exitInterviewDescri.description: Reassures the participant that exiting preserves their answers for resuming.

interview.navigation.exitInterviewTitle.description: Confirmation title before leaving an unfinished interview.

interview.navigation.exitReview.description: Action to leave the temporary interview review.

interview.navigation.exitReviewDescripti.defaultMessage: Changes made during this review will not be saved.
interview.navigation.exitReviewDescripti.description: Explains the temporary nature of answers changed in review mode.

interview.navigation.exitReviewTitle.description: Confirmation title before leaving an interview review.

interview.navigation.goToScreen.description: Accessible name for opening the interview screen navigation drawer.

interview.navigation.hiddenScreen.defaultMessage: This screen is hidden based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?
interview.navigation.hiddenScreen.description: Explains why an interview screen is hidden before overriding that navigation rule.

interview.navigation.increaseTextSize.description: Accessible action that increases interview text size.

interview.navigation.interfaceLanguage.description: Label for the language of the interview package's built-in controls; protocol text is separate.

interview.navigation.interviewSettings.description: Accessible name of the settings popover inside a running interview.

interview.navigation.nextStep.description: Accessible name of the arrow that moves to the next interview screen.

interview.navigation.outsidePath.defaultMessage: This screen is outside the current interview path based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?
interview.navigation.outsidePath.description: Explains that a screen is outside the current answer-dependent path before opening it.

interview.navigation.previousStep.description: Accessible name of the arrow that moves to the previous interview screen.

interview.navigation.settings.description: Accessible name of the interview settings button.

interview.navigation.showScreen.description: Action that opens an otherwise unavailable interview screen.

interview.navigation.showTitle.description: Confirmation title before opening an interview screen hidden by earlier answers.

interview.navigation.textSize.description: Legend for the text-size input; hidden adds the percentage unit for screen readers.

interview.runtime.addPerson.description: Accessible action that adds a person to the current interview task.

interview.runtime.canvas.description: Announced name of the area where items can be positioned.

interview.runtime.collapseDrawer.description: Accessible action that folds the item tray closed.

interview.runtime.copied.description: Confirmation that interview diagnostic information was copied.

interview.runtime.copyClipboard.description: Tooltip for copying diagnostic information about an interview error.

interview.runtime.copyDebugInfo.description: Button that copies interview error details for the study organizer.

interview.runtime.decryptFailed.defaultMessage: There was an error decrypting the data with the passphrase entered. Please try again.
interview.runtime.decryptFailed.description: Error after the entered passphrase could not decrypt the data.

interview.runtime.decryptRetry.defaultMessage: There was a problem decrypting the data. Please re-enter your passphrase.
interview.runtime.decryptRetry.description: Message asking for another passphrase after decryption fails.

interview.runtime.deleteBin.description: Announced name of the drop target that deletes an item.

interview.runtime.drawer.description: Announced name of the tray containing items that can be placed.

interview.runtime.dropToRemove.description: Hint shown on the tray when dropping an item removes its position.

interview.runtime.enterPassphrase.description: Title of the dialog for revealing encrypted interview data.

interview.runtime.expandDrawer.description: Accessible action that expands the item tray.

interview.runtime.filter.description: Placeholder for filtering the interview screen navigation list.

interview.runtime.finishConfirmationDesc.defaultMessage: Finish this interview only when you are satisfied with your responses.
interview.runtime.finishConfirmationDesc.description: Default finish confirmation; the host may supply its own context-specific explanation.

interview.runtime.finishFailed.defaultMessage: The interview could not be finished. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.
interview.runtime.finishFailed.description: Recoverable finish-dialog error after saving pending answers or the host finish request fails; no claim is made that all responses have been submitted.

interview.runtime.firstNode.description: Fallback accessible name for the first item when its name is missing.

interview.runtime.hiddenByAnswers.description: Status on a screen unavailable because of answers given so far.

interview.runtime.interviewScreens.description: Accessible name of the interview screen navigation list.

interview.runtime.itemUnavailable.defaultMessage: This item could not be displayed.
interview.runtime.itemUnavailable.description: Fallback when protocol-provided media cannot be displayed.

interview.runtime.loadingVideo.description: Status while a protocol-provided video is loading.

interview.runtime.minimumItems.defaultMessage: You must create at least {count, number} {count, plural, one {item} other {items}} before you can continue.
interview.runtime.minimumItems.description: Blocking message when too few items have been created; emphasize the minimum count.

interview.runtime.noSearchMatch.description: Empty result after searching the interview screen list.

interview.runtime.nodeList.description: Accessible name for a list of people or other items.

interview.runtime.notifications.description: Accessible name of the interview notification region.

interview.runtime.offlineMap.defaultMessage: You are offline — the map will not load until you reconnect.
interview.runtime.offlineMap.description: Persistent message while a map screen cannot load offline.

interview.runtime.offlineTaskDescription.defaultMessage: You appear to be offline, and this task could not be displayed. Some tasks (such as maps) need a connection. If the problem persists once you are back online, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below.
interview.runtime.offlineTaskDescription.description: Recovery instructions when an interview task cannot be displayed without a network connection.

interview.runtime.offlineTaskTitle.defaultMessage: This task needs an internet connection
interview.runtime.offlineTaskTitle.description: Error heading when an interview task cannot run offline.

interview.runtime.outsideCurrentPath.description: Status on a screen outside the currently selected interview path.

interview.runtime.passphrase.description: Label of the secret phrase input used to decrypt interview data.

interview.runtime.passphraseHelp.defaultMessage: Enter your passphrase in order to unlock the data on this screen. If you cannot remember your passphrase, please contact the person who recruited you to this study.
interview.runtime.passphraseHelp.description: Instructions for unlocking encrypted data and finding help if the passphrase is forgotten.

interview.runtime.passphraseNeeded.defaultMessage: Your passphrase is needed to show data on this screen. Click here to enter it.
interview.runtime.passphraseNeeded.description: Explains why a passphrase is needed to reveal data on the current screen.

interview.runtime.passphrasePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the interview decryption passphrase input.

interview.runtime.secondNode.description: Fallback accessible name for the second item when its name is missing.

interview.runtime.submissionFailed.defaultMessage: An error occurred while submitting the form.
interview.runtime.submissionFailed.description: Generic form error when no submit handler exists or it throws unexpectedly.

interview.runtime.submitPassphrase.description: Action that submits a passphrase to decrypt interview data.

interview.runtime.taskComplete.defaultMessage: You have completed this task. Click the next arrow to continue.
interview.runtime.taskComplete.description: Notification that the maximum item count is reached and the participant can continue.

interview.runtime.taskErrorDescription.defaultMessage: There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed. Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.
interview.runtime.taskErrorDescription.description: Recovery instructions for an unexpected interview screen failure.

interview.runtime.taskErrorTitle.description: Heading when an interview screen cannot be rendered.

interview.runtime.unnamedRosterItem.description: Fallback label for an external-roster item with no usable name; subject is protocol-authored and number is a stable position.

interview.runtime.unplacedCount.description: Number of items in the tray that have not yet been placed on the canvas.

interview.runtime.untitledStage.description: Fallback for an interview screen with no authored label.

interview.runtime.videoUnavailable.description: Error when a protocol-provided video cannot load.
